firstPlayerRule: The player to the dealer’s left starts by leading any single card or set of equal cards. After everyone passes, whoever played last leads again.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker.

sources.title: Presidents — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Presidents page. "The player to dealer’s left starts by leading (face up) any single card or any set of cards of equal rank (for example three fives)." "the player who played last (and highest) to the previous ‘trick’ starts again by leading any card or set of equal cards."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the dealer is chosen.
